career_ladder.note: Chandigarh Administration Department of Personnel manages the Common Cadre (Ministerial) for Group 'C' and Group 'B' non-gazetted and gazetted secretarial posts across Chandigarh UT administrative departments. Clerks enter at Pay Level 2 and progress through Junior Assistant (Level 5) to Senior Assistant (Level 6), followed by supervisory appointments as Superintendent Grade-II (Level 6/7) and Superintendent Grade-I (Level 8/9). Steno-Typists enter at Pay Level 3 and advance through Junior Scale and Senior Scale Stenographer posts.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Clerk and Steno-Typist posts in Chandigarh Administration consists of an objective Written Examination followed by a mandatory qualifying Skill Test (English Typing Test for Clerks; Stenography and Transcription Test for Steno-Typists) and Document Verification including verification of mandatory ICT/CCC 80-hour certification.

stages.stage_name: Stage 1: Written Examination (Objective Multiple Choice Test)
stages.source_label: Chandigarh Administration Group C Recruitment Scheme and Syllabus

stages.stage_name: Stage 2: Skill Test (Typing Test / Stenography Test) (Qualifying Only)
stages.source_label: Chandigarh Administration Department of Personnel Typing Test Standard Order

papers.paper_name: English Computer Typing Test (For Clerk Posts)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum net speed of 35 words per minute (wpm) on computer; speed below 35 wpm is disqualified

papers.paper_name: Stenography & Computer Transcription Test (For Steno-Typist Posts)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Stenography dictation at 80 wpm for 10 minutes; computer transcription within 50 minutes (English) or 65 minutes (Hindi)

financial_package.pay_source_label: Chandigarh Administration Public Appointment Notice No. 588537(E)-IH(11)-2026/73999 (Pay Level 2 as per 7th CPC for Clerk, Level 3 for Steno-Typist)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated for Clerk at Level 2 entry basic pay (₹19,900) with 58% Central DA, 18% HRA (Class Y city - Chandigarh UT), and Transport Allowance (₹1,350 + DA). Steno-Typists are appointed at Pay Level 3 (₹21,700 entry basic, gross ₹39,000 - ₹46,000). Deductions include 10% NPS contribution on Basic + DA and UT Group Insurance.
official_perks: House Rent Allowance (18% in Chandigarh UT - Category Y city) or government accommodation
Transport Allowance (₹1,350 + 58% DA for Pay Level 1-2)
Medical reimbursement under Central Services (Medical Attendance) Rules / CGHS empanelled facilities
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and defined contribution pension under NPS
Earned leave, casual leave, child care leave, and maternity/paternity entitlements

competition_benchmarks.note: Chandigarh Administration Group 'C' Clerk & Steno-Typist recruitment attracts substantial candidate participation across Chandigarh, Punjab, and Haryana due to central pay commission rules and administrative cadre stability. The 2026 cycle notified 257 total vacancies (234 Clerk, 23 Steno-Typist) under recruitment notice No. 588537(E)-IH(11)-2026/73999.
